title: Length of padded bit sources
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet with $k$ work tapes, and let $l$ be a finite list of bit sources. If $|l|$ is at most the configuration arity of $M$ (the number of possible snapshots of $M$, plus $2k+13$), then padding $l$ with false constants to that arity produces a list of length exactly the configuration arity.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the binary alphabet, with finite state set and $k$ work tapes
A finite list $l$ of bit sources
The length of $l$ is at most the configuration arity of $M$
